title: Extend the CLI-owned direct-edit deny set to cells, lanes and onboarding
action: Per guard-hardening E2 (CONTEXT.md) and the plan Constraints. Extend direct_edit_verb (write_guard/guards.rs:41-52) so hand-edits via Edit/Write/MultiEdit/Bash-mutation are denied for: .bee/cells/*.json, .bee/lanes/*.json, .bee/onboarding.json - matching style consistent with the existing five enumerated entries (the existing set matches exact relative paths; for cells/lanes use a prefix+extension match in the same function, keep it readable). EXPLICITLY preserved as writable: .bee/config.json and .bee/decisions.jsonl (sanctioned agent surfaces) - do not touch scratch_shape_deny allowances. Check the deny message names the owning CLI verb (cells add/finish, state lanes/start-feature --as-lane, onboard) so the agent hitting it knows the sanctioned path. Add regression tests asserting: deny on a .bee/cells/x.json edit, deny on .bee/lanes/x.json, deny on .bee/onboarding.json, ALLOW preserved on .bee/config.json and .bee/decisions.jsonl. Existing tests must pass unmodified; a required change to one is STOP-and-report. Run the full suite (commands.test) and quote the summary.

truths: cells, lanes and onboarding.json hand-edits denied with a message naming the owning verb
config.json and decisions.jsonl remain writable, proven by tests

trace.outcome: E2/E2a landed: direct_edit_verb denies .bee/cells|lanes/*.json and onboarding.json naming owning verbs; config.json and decisions.jsonl allowances proven; three legacy tests flipped per decision E2a; write_guard 84/0, full suite 998/1 (known environmental red only).
